Official Oregon Ducks Shop: Oregon Gear, Apparel & Gifts

Shop.GoDucks.com is your official online resource for everything UO to help you celebrate every season, including Oregon NIL jerseys and Oregon Nike Pegasus shoes! Dress yourself in the latest University of Oregon Apparel featuring licensed Oregon Ducks football gear, T-shirts, Jerseys, Hats and Sweatshirts from top brands like Nike Oregon Sportswear. Get the latest officially licensed team clothing and accessories to show your allegiance wherever you go. Show your support for your Ducks with official Oregon Gameday and Tailgate merchandise, as well as Oregon Ducks clothing and Basketball apparel. Our UO merchandise selection also includes University of Oregon collectibles, automotive gear, tailgating supplies and UO clothing for men, women and kids. Don't forget to shop for University of Oregon Gifts to make every UO Duck fan happy on gameday or any day.

Ducks Football Gear

Discover the ultimate selection of Oregon Ducks football gear at the Oregon Ducks Online Store. Shop the latest Nike arrivals at GoDucks, including official Oregon sideline polos, Oregon Ducks jerseys, and Oregon Nike Sideline Gear worn by the team. Dive into our range of officially licensed apparel and merchandise, including iconic jerseys, stylish hats, and premium tailgate essentials. Every item showcases the distinctive green and yellow of the Ducks, making it easy to support your team with pride. Whether you’re at Autzen Stadium or cheering from home, our gear keeps you connected to the action. Gear up and flaunt your Ducks spirit!

Oregon Ducks Basketball Jerseys & Apparel

Elevate your game-day experience with Oregon Ducks basketball gear from the Oregon Ducks Online Store. Browse our exclusive collection of officially licensed merchandise, from sleek jerseys and comfortable hoodies to eye-catching hats and accessories. Each piece showcases the vibrant green and yellow of the Ducks, allowing you to cheer on your team in style. Whether you’re hitting the court or watching from the stands, our gear keeps you united with the Ducks’ winning spirit.

Oregon Baseball and Softball Merch

Get ready for the season with Oregon Ducks baseball gear and Oregon softball gear from the Oregon Ducks Online Store. Our collection features officially licensed gear that captures the spirit of Oregon athletics, including performance jerseys, classic tees, and durable hats. Show off your Ducks pride with gear that stands up to any game, whether you're at the ballpark or cheering from home. Dive into our selection and celebrate every home run and strikeout in true Ducks fashion.
